tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga'i skor bzhugs so// sa lugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru we/ srod dang tho rangs langs par byas nas// gnyis gsum bdun du mngon par brjod na// bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur zhing*// nor 'dod pas ni nor rnams nyid thob// 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te// bgegs rnams med cing so sor 'joms 'gyur// zhes pa la brten nas maṇḍal bzhi pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gsum/ dus dang*/ gnas dang*/ rten dang mchod pa bsham pa'o// dus ni bsod nams gsog pa yin na tshes brgyad dam nya stong lta bu la bya/ bar chad sel na nad rims dang*/ 'dre dang chom rkun la sogs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang rmi lam ngan pa la sogs pa byung ba'i dus su'o// 'dod pa'i don sgrub na nangs par lta bu don bsgrub pa'i do nub bya ste dus su'o// gnas ni gtsug lag khang ngam mchod khang la sogs pa nyams dga' bar bya'o// rten ni bla ma yi dam spyi dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten lugs ma dang ras bris la sogs pa ci rigs pa dgram/ rje btsun ma'i sku lugs ma'am bris sku gang rung zhig bzhugs su gzhug go /mchod pa ni steng du bla re/ rnga yab la sogs pa ci rigs pas brgyan/ maṇḍal ni re gas maṇḍal zlum po khor yug gnyis pa bzhi bri'o// yang na shing ngam 'khar ba'i maṇḍal bzhi/ gcig las med na'ang bskyar la dbul/ mar me bzhi/ lha bshos bzhi/ grub na reng bu bzhi/ yon chab dang*/ dri mchog rnams grub na bzhi bzhi/ med na ci rigs pa bsham mo// me tog ni zangs gzhong la sogs par bsags la gsol ba 'debs tsa na 'thor zhing bya'o// dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ba dang*/ dkon mchog spyi la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la// byang chub ma thob par du bdag skyabs mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces brjod la don yid la bya'o// gnyis pa dkon mchog spyi la mchod pa bya ba ni/ dang po bla ma la phyag bya/ de nas yi dam la/ de nas buddha la/ de nas byang sems la phyag bya/ de nas mchod pa dang maṇḍal dang po dbul/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa'am bsdus pa gang rung pa zhig byas la/ 'dod pa'i don gang bsgrub pa de la gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// gsum pa rje btsun ma la gsol ba gdab pa la gsum ste/ dang po rje btsun ma'i rten mdun du bshams la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas po ta la nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim mo// yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun ma'i rnam par spyan drangs la bstim mo// de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor mos par byas te ngag tu/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma// dpa' mo tā re tuttā re// sangs rgyas zhal gyi padma yi// ge sar las byung khyod la 'dud// ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi// dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ma// mchog sbyin phyag rgya utpal// bsnams ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i gzeb las tu re yis// swā hās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzod// oṃ gyi ngo bo nyid kyis ni// tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed khyod la 'dud// 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las ni// 'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad// kun gyi ma ru gyur pa yi// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ de nas mchod pa dbul ba ni ngag tu/ dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu// thang skyes chu skyes chu chen me tog bcas// dri zhim yid 'ong mchod yon dam pa 'di// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra arghaṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod 'bul ma// puṣpe dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// thang skyes chu skyes me tog dkon mang bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra puṣpe pū dza āḥhūm̐/

dus gsum rgyal ba'i shangs la mchod 'bul ma// spos ma dud ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// lhan skyes sbyar dang yongs gyur spos khang bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra dhū pe pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan la mchod 'bul ma// dī paṃ dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// nyi zla rin chen snang gsal sna tshogs bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra ā lo ke pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod 'bul ma// dri ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// a gar tsandan ga pur dung chos bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra gandhe pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod 'bul ma// ro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// ro dang bcud ldan lha rdzas zhal zas bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra nai wi dya pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i snyan la mchod 'bul ma// sgra ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// pi wang gling bu sil snyan sna tshogs bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par bgyi// gu ru tā rā badzra shabda pū dza āḥhūm̐/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing chag chag btab// ri rab gling bzhis legs par brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs nas phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog /gu ru tā rā badzra maṇḍal pū dza āḥhūm̐/ de nas sgrol ma la blo bkal ba'i dad gus kyi bsam pa rtse gcig pas bstod pa tshar gnyis gdon/ de nas dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig bya ste/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// kun nas dwangs bas phyag 'tshal lo// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul// 'phags ma'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// so so skye bo la sogs pa'i// rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa yi// bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang*// sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*// blo yi bye brag ji lta bar// che chung thun mong theg pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs par// mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba yi// sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol// bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa// thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas// ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi// 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/ces pa'i yan lag bdun pa bya'o// de nas rang dang mdun gyi rje btsun ma dmigs pa gsal bar byas la/ rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa sum brgya bgrang ngo*// de'ang nad zhi bar 'dod na/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re sarba gra he bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes brjod/ de bzhin du gdon zhi bar 'dod na/ sarba du ṭhān bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes brjod/ bgegs zhi bar 'dod na/ sarba bighnān bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes brjod/ rims nad zhi bar 'dod na/ sarba dzwā re bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dus min 'chi ba la/ a kā la mṛ tyu/ ltas ngan pa la/ durni mi te/ rmi lam ngan pa la/ dursāpni/ rnam g.yeng la/ tsitta ku le bhyaḥzhes brjod/ dgra dang chom rkun nyer 'tshe zhi bar 'dod na/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes brjod/ de nas rje btsun ma la rtse gcig tu dmigs la yi ge gnyis kyi sbyor ba bla ma kha che ba'i gdams ngag tā re zhes pa sum brgya brjod/ de nas maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab ste/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// sgrib gnyis byang nas tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol// de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang*// lha dang mi yi bde ba mchog thob nas// thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa yi// bar chad gdon bgegs rims dang nad la sogs// dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang*// 'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams// myur du zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// 'jig rten 'jig rten las ni 'das pa yi// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rnams// 'phel zhing rgyas nas bsam pa'i don rnams kun// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// sgrub la brtson zhing dam chos 'phel ba dang*// rtag tu khyed sgrub zhal mchog mthong ba dang*// stong nyid don rtogs byang sems rin po che// yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel rgyas mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/

rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// padmo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /bkra shis ni/ bdag gis tshe rabs kun nas bsgrubs pa'i lha// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma// sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhing dpa'// yum gyur utpal bsnams pa'i bkra shis shog /rje btsun ma la gsol 'debs maṇḍal dang mchod pa tshar gsum du dbul ba las dang po'o// gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 'jig rten gsum mgon yum gyur spyan yangs ma// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// gnyis med ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don sna tshogs mdzad// byams pa'i yum gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog ljang gus phrin las sna tshogs mdzad// yon tan rab rgyas bcu drug lon pa'i tshul// 'gro la rab dges zhal ni 'dzum pa dang*// zhi ba'i spyan gyis 'jig rten gsum la gzigs// thugs rje che mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang sems rang bzhin zla ba gdan du bting*// nyon mongs mi skyod rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// sgrib pa kun spangs padma'i gdan la bzhugs// zag med bde rgyas zla ba'i rgyab yol can// zag med bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// na bza' mchog dang rin chen du mas spras// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin sgrub la dngos grub ster// g.yon pas utpal skyon bral dag pa'i rtags// phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab bzung du 'brel// mtha' bral zung 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas gong ma bzhin mchod 'bul byas la/ bstod pa tshar gsum bton la/ yan lag bdun pa nas bkra shis kyi bar sngar dang 'dra/ rje btsun ma'i maṇḍal dang mchod pa gnyis pa'o// gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ thugs rje chen po sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag stong spyan stong sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sman pa'i rgyal po sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje thabs mkhas sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sa ltar brtan gyur sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// chu ltar bsil gyur sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// me ltar smin mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// rlung ltar rgyas mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag 'tshal/

mchod 'bul gong dang 'dra/ de nas bstod pa tshar bdun gdon/ yan lag bdun pa sngar dang 'dra/ de nas rtsa sngags la gang zhi bar 'dod pa'i spel tshig btags la stong du kha tshang bar bya ba'i phyir bzhi brgya bgrang ngo*// gong ma bzhin yi ge gnyis kyi sbyor ba tā re zhes pa bzhi brgya bgrang ngo*// de nas maṇḍal tha ma dbul/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can zhes pa nas/ bkra shis kyi bar sngar dang 'dra ste maṇḍal bzhi pa'o// mthar mchod 'bul bya ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi bar la long yod cing spros pa la dga' na dbyangs su grub na'ang dga'o// ma grub na tshigs bcad kyis kyang btub bo// mjug dge ba bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa myur du thob nas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du skem par gyur cig sems can ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol ba'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig sems can ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig sems can mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las zlo bar byed pa'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la rjes su slob cing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che spyad pa la mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig sgrol ma'i maṇḍal bzhi pa'i gsol 'debs rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o/// / gtor ma bzhi pa bshams pa'i dang po bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba la dbul/ gnyis pa chos skyong la phul la phrin las gzhol/ gsum pa rigs drug kun la sbyin/ bzhi pa gzhi bdag la tshims par sbyin no// 'di bris dge bas rje btsun ma// mnyes nas bdag gi sdig sgrib rnams// bsal nas 'gro ba'i don du ni// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga bklag chog ma 'dod don lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan mar gad rdul brtsegs lhun po ni// rab mdzes mtshan dpe nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// ma lus 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs kyi gtso// lha mchog myur ma dpa' mos 'gro 'di srungs// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las ma// phongs pa las sgrol sgrol ma la// btud de de yi bstod pa yi// cho ga lag len bzhin du bri// 'di la sbyor dngos rjes kyi dang po la gsum gyi/ dus ni bsod nams gsog na tshes brgyad nya stong lta bu/ bar chad sel na rims 'dre gdon phyi rol gyi dmag tshogs rmi lam ngan pa la sogs bar chad byung ba'i dus su/ 'dod pa sgrub na nangs par lta bu don bsgrub pa'i do nub bya'o// gnas ni gtsug lag khang ngam nyams dga' ba'o// rten ni bla ma yi dam spyi dang dkon mchog spyi'i lugs sku'am ras bris la sogs pa dang*/ rje btsun ma'i lugs sku'am ras bris gang rung bzhugs su bcug mchod pa ni steng du bla re rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan/ maṇḍal re khā zlum po khor yug gnyis pa bzhi bri/ tshom bu bdun dgod/ yang na shing ngam 'khar ba rdo sogs kyis rung*/ gcig las med kyang bskyar la dbul/ mchod yon/ me tog reng bu/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas rnams tshan pa bzhi bzhi bsham/ ma 'byor na ci 'byor du bsham zhes gsungs pas gzhan rnams kha gso/ zhal zas bzhi dang gtor ma gsum mam gcig la bsdus kyang rung*/ me tog ni zangs gzhong sogs su bteg nas gsol ba 'debs dus su 'thor ro// ting shag gam dril bu sogs kyang sta gon bya/ chab blangs la stan la 'dug dngos gzhi la dkon mchog spyi dang*/ rje btsun ma la gsol ba 'debs pa gnyis kyi dang po ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis mchod pa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du am̐ las mchod yon/ pām̐ las zhabs bsil/ bam̐ las me tog dhām̐ las bdug spos/ dām̐ las mar me/ gam̐ las dri chab/ nam̐ las zhal zas/ sham̐ las rol mo/ hūm̐ las mchod rdzas gzhan rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zhes so so'i ming gi yi ge dang po las mchod rdzas so sor bskyed pa'am/ bsdu na/ rin po che'i snod du zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgya dang tshad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du gnas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pā ra mi ta/ nā da saṃ bha we/ badzra dharma hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.ā khaṃ swā hā/ rol mos byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs bzhi skor byas pas chog gsungs/ rjes la/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig duḥkha med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig

ces pas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// bla ma brgyud pa yi dam dkon mchog gsum sogs dpag med spyan drangs/ mdun du rin po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par bsgoms la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum la rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol ba// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam thob pa// bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas// zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung dang*// shākya thub pa gau tam lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung bcom pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i pha rol tu// phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag bskyab pa'i phyir// smon lam khyad par can rnams btab gyur pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen can khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gyur pa ni thams cad la// mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' zhing*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*// gang du byang chub la reg dang*// zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// zag med mya ngan 'das phyag 'tshal// bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*// 'chags pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi// gnas de la yang phyag 'tshal lo// steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*// skur bcas sku ni med pa yi// mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las bskyed ba'i sras// byang chub spyod pa bla med mthar phyin pa// shākya'i rgyal po'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur pa// mgon po mi pham pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rga shi'i 'jigs spangs gzhon nur gyur pa de// gzhan don dgyes pas zhal ras 'dzum pa can// sna tshogs sprul mdzad 'od zer mtha' yas pa// bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi rje// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus dpyis 'byin pa// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// brtse ba'i thugs rjes dbang phyug nyid kyi sku// drang srong chen po'i tshul du bstan nas kyang*// 'gro ba'i gdung ba drag po sel mdzad pa// bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba nyid kyang thugs rje'i dbang gis na// lha mo'i tshul ston kun nas gsal ba'i sku// yid bzhin nor bu padma legs bsnams pa// shes rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang klu dbang grub pa'i cod pan gyi// rin chen 'od zer 'phro bas gang gi zhabs// kun nas gsal bas nyi ma'ang zil gnon pa// phongs pa kun skyob sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud// brtse bas rjes chags padma rā ga'i mdog

/zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku// mda' gzhu utpal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin// bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba 'jigs pas nyen pa bskyab pa'i phyir// brtse bas 'jigs byed khro mo'i skur bstan nas// dbugs 'byin mdzad cing dngos grub mchog stsol ma// sgrol ma drag mo 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mar gad mdog mtshungs nyi ma lta bur gsal// nyon mongs dug 'joms rma bya'i mjug sgro dang*// dngos grub kun stsol bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin// rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// bar du gcod pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing*// dri med bde ba chen po thob mdzad pa// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku// ye shes ral gri rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen nam mkha'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing*// dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ gi 'brug stong chems// 'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa// phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma lus rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes las// nye bar bsgrubs pa'i mthu stobs rdo rje yis// bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms byed pa// dpa' chen rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir rab khros pa// bye ru'i mdog mtshungs padma'i dbyug to 'dzin// rta mchog zhal gyis dgra yi dpung 'joms pa// khro rgyal rta mgrin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs byung zhing*// sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byung lnga'i mdog can 'byung chen lnga la dbang*// kun tu sgyur byed rdo rje'i 'dab gshog can// klu yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal gyur pa// rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs srung ba// rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa// nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// dgra bcom blo mchog dbang po kun dul ba// bstan pa'i srid du legs par brtan bzhugs nas// bstan pa 'dzin dang skyong dang srung mdzad pa// 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug bzhugs pa ni// gnas brtan bha ra dhā dza bsod snyoms len// 'phags pa gser can ba ku la dang ni// gnas brtan lam brtan rdo rje mo yi bu// 'phags pa sbed byed sgra gcan 'dzin dang ni// klu yi sde dang gnas brtan yan lag 'byung*// nags na gnas dang dgra bcom ma pham pa// lam phran brtan dang gser phreng mi phyed pa// dus ldan bzang po zhes bya la phyag 'tshal// 'dzam bu gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs// kha ba can 'dir chos kyi sgron me sbar// ngur smig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras kyi gtso// mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la phyag 'tshal lo// rang don yal bar dor nas gzhan gyi don// lhur mdzad de ni gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal// dngos sam brgyud pas gzhan gyi don mdzad pa// dpal ldan a ti sha la phyag 'tshal lo// sa chen 'di na ngo mtshar rnam mang yang*// rgya gar kha che rgya nag bal bod li// yul gang na yang mtshungs med chos kyi rje// 'dzam gling sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// zhes pa nas/

thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra su re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gis bskor ba/ hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu

tshigs bcad 'di dpe phal cher du 'og gi maṇḍal tshig lhug pa'i mjug bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i mtshams su snang*/ gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ gu ru tri ratna maṇḍa la pū dza āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran bzhin pas/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas/ kun tu yang sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa chen po'o zhes brjod/ de nas maṇḍal la sogs pa yod na phul/ med na me tog thogs la thal mo sbyar nas skabs skabs su 'thor zhing*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bla ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa/ da ltar bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring ba rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa/ sems can rnams la bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs shing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis rgyud la skyes nas 'phags pa rnams dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la gnas te/ don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten tu char chu dus su phebs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ nad dang 'khrug pa mu ge med cing bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa/

khyad par sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi nad gdon bar chad zhi/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel/ dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ tshe ring nad med 'byor ldan zhing*// 'gro kun rtag tu 'dun pa dang*// ji ltar bsam pa'i don rnams kun// chos bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba las// sems can rnams ni rab slu ba'i// bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol// rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la// phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi// bar du gcod pa thams cad kun// nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba yi// yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog /ces pas gsol ba btab pa ni maṇḍal dang po bla ma dkon mchog la dbul ba'i cho ga'o// maṇḍal gnyis pa rje btsun mar maṇḍal gsum 'bul ba'i dang po ni/ mdun na rje btsun ma'i rten yod na/ yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan la dang*/ rten med na rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar padma dang zla ba'i gdan la ste gang ltar yang*/ tām̐ yig ljang gu las gyur pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon utpa la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol dang 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas po ta la nas/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang mthar thal mo sbyar la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing sogs nas/ yongs bdag 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ po ta la yi gnas mchog nas// tām̐ yig ljang gu las 'khrungs shing*// 'od dpag med pas dbu la brgyan// dus gsum sangs rgyas phrin las ma// 'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod mdun du bzhugs pa la/ btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur byon tshur byon zhi bdag lha// thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// zhes pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs la/ khyed kyi rang bzhin yang dag pas// srid pa'i 'ching ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du// gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol// spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ gis khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ tām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā zhes pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur pa'i// na gza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa dang*// gos bzang srab la 'jam mdzes sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul// oṃ badzra wast+ra a laṃ kā ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ gis gos rgyan dang*/

bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badzra ā sa na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ me tog gtor nas/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrje btsun ma la thim pas de nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa mos la/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma// dpa' mo tā re tuttā re// sangs rgyas zhal gyi padma yi// ge dpe kha cig la bar 'dir gnas gsum byin rlabs spyi ltar snang na'ang rje btsun chen po'i yig char mi gsal/ sar las byung khyod la 'dud// ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi// dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ma// mchog sbyin phyag rgya utpa la// bsnams ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i gzeb las tu re yis// swā hās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad// oṃ gyi ngo bo nyid kyis ni// tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed khyod la 'dud// 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las ni// 'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad// kun gyi ma ru gyur pa yi// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs gnyis padmo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag byas te stan la 'dug nas mchod pa gsar pa brje ba'am yang na kha gsos la/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin las bsdu na dharmā ra ṇi ta mi dgos so// de nas/ dri med gtsang zhing yan lag brgyad ldan chu// thang skyes chu skyes chu chen me tog bcas// dri zhim yid 'ong ldan pa'i mchod yon 'di// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul// oṃ gu ru tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbu la mchod 'bul ma// puṣpe dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// thang skyes chu skyes me tog dkon mang bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul// oṃ gu ru tā rā sa pa ri wā ra puṣpāe pū dza āḥhūm̐/

dus gsum rgyal ba'i shangs la mchod 'bul ma// spos ma dud ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// lhan skyes sbyar dang yongs gyur spos khang bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul// oṃ gu ru tā rā sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan la mchod 'bul ma// dī paṃ dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// nyi zla rin chen snang gsal sna tshogs bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul// oṃ gu ru tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs la mchod 'bul ma// dri ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// a gar tsandan ga bur dung chos bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul// oṃ gu ru tā rā sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ljags la mchod 'bul ma// ro ma dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// ro dang bcud ldan lha rdzas zhal zas bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul// oṃ gu ru tā rā sa pa ri wa ra nai wi dya pū dza āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i snyan la mchod 'bul ma// sgra ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// pi wang gling bu sil snyan sna tshogs bsnams// rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum la mchod par 'bul// oṃ gu ru tā rā sa pa ri ra shabda pū dza āḥhūm̐ rol mo bya ste mchod pa dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐ sogs maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma las/ khyad par 'di nyid rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ gu ru tā rā badzra maṇḍal pū dza āḥhūm̐ gis maṇḍal dbul/

de nas rje btsun ma la yid rtse gcig tu gtad de phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi phan yon dran pas/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo sogs nas/ 'joms pa tu re rab mchog nyid ma// rtsa ba'i sngags kyi bstod pa 'di dang*// phyag 'tshal ba ni nyi shu rtsa gcig /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod pa tshar gnyis 'don zhing phyag byas nas stan la 'dug ste/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang sogs nas/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig ces pa dge slong ma dpal mos mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa byas nas/ rje btsun ma'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig ljang gu'i mthar oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas bdag sogs kyi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar byas/ tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byas par dmigs nas/ 'dod pa'i don gang yin pa de yid yul du byas te yi ge bcu pa sum brgya bgrang*/ yi ge gnyis kyi sbyor ba zhes pa/ tā re zhes pa'ang sum brgya bzla/ 'di ni thun mong gi 'dod don zhu ba'i dbang du byas la/ dmigs bsal gyi don zhu ba'i ched du byed na/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re zhes pa'i mtshams su nad zhi ba la/ sarba gra he bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gdon la/ sarba duṣṭān bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bgegs la/ sarba bighnān bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rims la/ sarba dzwā re bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nyer 'tshe la/ sarba u pa dra be bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la/ sarba a kā la mṛ tyu bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ltas ngan pa la/ sarba durni mi te bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rmi lam ngan pa la/ sarba dur swapni bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rnam g.yeng la/ sarba tsitta ku le bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā kun la sbyar ba'i spel tshig can dang*/ tā re zhes pa sum brgya brjod do// thun mong ba dang khyad par gnyis gang bzlas kyang*/

de nas sa gzhi spos chus sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra bhu mi sogs maṇḍal sngar ltar 'bul/ de nas me tog 'thor zhing*/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi sogs nas/ yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod ces gsol ba gdab/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der// padmo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes// snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du// lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /ces pas smon lam dang*/ bdag gis tshe rabs kun tu bsgrubs pa'i lha// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma// sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis myur zhing dpa'// yum gyur utpal bsnams pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pas bkra shis brjod/ me tog gtor la/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas zhes sogs gong ltar brjod pa ni spyi'i maṇḍal gnyis pa'o// rje btsun mar maṇḍal gsum 'bul ba'i gnyis pa ni/ yang mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin las/ 'jig rten gsum mgon yum gyur spyan yangs pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// gnyis med ye shes ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis phrin las sna tshogs mdzad// byams pa'i yum gyur khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog ljang gu phrin las sna tshogs mdzad// yon tan rab rgyas bcu drug lon pa'i tshul// 'gro la rab dgyes zhal ni 'dzum pa dang*// zhi ba'i spyan ni 'jig rten gsum la gzigs// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// byang sems rang bzhin zla ba gdan du bting*// nyon mongs mi bskyod rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas// sgrib pa kun spangs padma'i gdan la bzhugs// zag med bde rgyas zla ba'i rgyab yol can// zag med bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// na bza' mchog dang rin chen du mas spras// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin sgrub la dngos sgrub ster// g.yon pas utpal skyon bral dag pa'i rtags// phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel// mtha' bral zung 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag 'tshal/

dri med gtsang zhing sogs nas/ maṇḍal bshams nas 'bul ba'i bar gong bzhin dang*/ de nas/ oṃ rje btsun ma sogs nas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig ces pa'i bar bstod pa tshar gsum dang phyag bya zhing bdun rnam dag dang*/ yi ge bcu pa sum brgya dang*/ tā re zhes pa sum brgya dang*/ dmigs bsal gyi 'dod don zhu ba'i bzlas pa'ang 'dra/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs sogs dang maṇḍal 'bul/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can sogs nas bkra shis shog gi bar sngar bzhin brjod pa ni spyi'i maṇḍal gsum pa'o// rje btsun mar maṇḍal 'bul ba'i gsum pa ni/ yang mchod pa rnams kha gso bsang sbyang byin rlabs byas nas/ thugs rje chen po sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag stong spyan stong sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sman pa'i rgyal po sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sman ltar nad 'joms sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje thabs mkhas sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sa ltar brtan gyur sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// chu ltar bsil mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// me ltar smin mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// rlung ltar rgyas mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' ltar khyab mdzad sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// gsung gi skyon spangs ka la ping ka'i dbyangs// thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya ma lus mkhyen// bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ dri med gtsang zhing sogs nas maṇḍal bshams pa 'bul ba nas gsol ba gdab pa'i bar sngar bzhin 'dra ba las/ bstod pa phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun 'don zhing phyag bya/ de nas phan yon dang yan lag bdun pa sngar bzhin gyi/ 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig ces pa nas yi ge bcu pa dang*/ tā re ste sngags gnyis po bzhi brgya bgrang ngo*// sngags spel tshig can yang 'dra/ de nas me tog 'thor bzhin pas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma sogs nas bkra shis shog gi bar brjod pa dang*/

khyad par du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ zhes sogs gong ltar brjod pa ni maṇḍal bzhi pa'o// rjes la gtor ma bsngo ba/ gtang rag gi mchod pa/ dge ba bsngo ba/ lhag chad skong ba/ bzod par gsol ba/ gshegs su gsol ba/ bkra shis brjod pa'o// dang po ni/ gtor ma bzhi bshams pa chab kyis bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur te lha rdzas kyi zhal zas su bskyed de oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dang po/ na maḥsarba buddha bodhi sa twā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa tī mahā satwa sarba buddha a wa lo ki te/ mā bi laṃ ba/ mā bi laṃ ba/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa la/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/ zhes gsum mam lngas rje btsun ma la 'bul/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma khyed la mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs sngar bzhin gsol ba btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'bru gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa gsum mam lngas chos skyong spyi la phul la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma khyad par can rnams la 'bul lo/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs kyi rjes su/ bde blag tu 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces brjod do// gsum pa ni yang 'bru gsum dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la phyag byas la/

a kā ro'am/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum mam lngas gtor ma byin la rjes su/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes pa tsam mam/ lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// thams cad du ni sdom pa legs// thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dwangs la rnyogs pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ gtor ma 'dis 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga skye ba rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la zas skom bdud rtsi'i char chen babs/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab bo// bzhi pa ni yang 'bru gsum dang*/ a kā ros gzhi bdag la bsngos la/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya sogs chos sbyin byin la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung zhing*/ bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ ces brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dkon mchog gi bstod pa bsdus pa'i rjes su/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing*// kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod// thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags// legs byas bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang*// sras bcas rgyal bar chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// de dag mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// dge tshogs 'gro bas byang chub thob phyir bsngo// zhes pas yan lag bdun pa dang*/

spro na/ bdag gis bcom ldan khyed sku legs bsgoms shing*// mthu chen gzungs sngags 'bad pas bzlas pa dang*// gus pas mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus sogs nas/ 'gro ba tshe yi dbul ba sel gyur cig /ces dang*/ 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu sogs nas/ bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog ces pa'i bar gang rung 'don/ mi nus na gong ltar/ tshe ring nad med sogs/ thabs dang skyabs dang sogs/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sogs/ khyod la bstod cing sogs/ bshes gnyen grogs mchog sogs dang*/ bdag gis sngar yang khyed la gsol btab pas// don de bde blag nyid du stsal lags kyis// da dung sgrol mas rjes su bzung gyur nas// nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang*// skye ba kun tu bstan la legs zhugs nas// yang dag bstan pa rab tu rgyas byed cing*// thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin nas// rgyal ba'i phrin las kun la dbang 'byor shog /ces pas gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis 'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon te/ rang gzhan 'khor 'das kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi mthu la brten nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa thob nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du skem par gyur cig sems can ma bsgral ba rnams sgrol ba'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig sems can ma grol ba rnams grol bar byed pa'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig sems can mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las 'da' ba'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi mtha' dag la slob cing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che byed pa'i mthu thogs pa med pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/

bzhi pa ni/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pa 'don pa'o// lnga pa ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod ces pa'i rjes su/ bdag cag so so'i skye bo bsam pa nyon mongs pa can du gyur pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin ma gsal zhing bying rgod kyi dbang du gyur pa dang*/ yo byad la dbang ma thob pas/ mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa/ gtsang sbras ma phyed pa/ cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa/ nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams la bzod par gsol lo// bdag cag la 'phral dang yun du sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod do// drug pa ni/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs nas/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra muḥye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas sam po ta lar gshegs par bsgom pa'am/ mdun gyi rten yod na nongs pa bzod gsol gyi rjes su/ ji srid du 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig pa de srid du ye shes pa rten 'di dag la brtan par bzhugs nas sbyin pa'i bdag pos thog drangs sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal

'di'i tshab tu/ bdag dang 'gro la nas/ padma ka ma la ya stāṃ gyis bzhugs su gsol zhing gdan phul zhes pa'ang snang*/ du gsol/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces dang*/ bdun pa ni/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te// sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*// skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*// nyin dang mtshan mo chos la spyod par shog /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal zhing bkra shis par gyur cig ces pa bkra shis brjod pa'o// ser bzhag mchan bsnan ngag 'don kun tshang ste// ser yod rnams kyang blo la gsol ba gces// lag len bde zhing byin rlabs shin tu myur// kun gyis ma chag dam bca' mdzad par rigs// sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi'i cho ga'i rim pa phyag len ltar bkod pa'o// phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs bcad rnams ni rang gis gang shes byas pas chog la/ chog khrigs rnams 'di kho na bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// dngos grub myur stsol rje btsun sgrol ma la// gsol ba gdab tshul gong ma'i gsung ngag bzhin// rin chen rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas dpal zhes pas// nye bar bskul phyir

a ba dhū ti pa'i btsun pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ bsod nams kyis sbyar ro// zhes dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i cho gar cung zad mi gsal ba rnams sngar gyi mchan rnying la slar yang gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po kun dga' tshul khrims kyi gsung rab la brten nas rang gi blo la 'jags dka' ba'i gnas 'ga' mchan sna bsrings yod pa las/ dpe blta bde ba'i ched du mchan dkyus su bcug nas bklag chog gi yi ge 'di bzhin gyis shig ces sa skyong bla ma sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ chos smra ba'i dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por bsdebs pa'o// 'di la chos rje bla ma'i gsung tshig gcig kyang ma lus pa'i zhabs tog gi tshul du sbyar pa yin pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis de bzhin dgongs par zhu/ mkhas la yongs grags byin rlabs mngon gyur pa'i// zab chos 'di 'dra rtswa bzhin 'dor byed pa'i// kye ho snyigs dus skye bo'i sdig 'di 'dra// bdag ni man ngag rtsad chod a la ho/ zhes kyang rang babs su smras so// 'di nyams su len pa rnams kyis bla ma brgyud ldan las lung dang lag len nos nas brtson par bya'o// brgyud pa ni thos yig tu shes par bya'o// slar yang 'di'i rtsa ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa nyid la/ phyis su tshig sna bsrings pa dang mchan dkyus su shor ba sogs kyis gzhung cung zad rgyas bsdus dang 'dra min mang du snang na'ang*/ rtsa ba'i yig cha dag snyam pa 'ga' re dang bstun nas tshig zur nyams pa 'ga' zhig dag par bgyis pa maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga bya tshul gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa// gtan gyi skyabs gcig rje btsun bcom ldan mar// nyer btud de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga 'bri// 'dir rje btsun sgrol ma'i maṇḍal bzhi pa bya bar 'dod pas gnas khang byi dor byas pa'i dbus su stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa stegs khebs sogs kyis bkab pa'i steng du rje btsun ma'i bris 'bur gyi rten yod na bsham/

de'i mdun du maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma bzhi bsham/ med na maṇḍal gcig la bskyar nas 'bul/ gtor ma zlum po bzhi'am gcig pus kyang rung*/ yon chab/ spos/ mar me/ zhal zas rnams bzhi'am bsdu na tshar re la kha gsos kyang chog de nas stan bde ba la 'dug nas kha bshal thog mar mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ bar dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs brjod la ting shag dkrol/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sogs shlo ka gcig mgon po thugs rje che ldan sogs shlo ka gcig dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i sogs shlo ka gcig grol nas grol ba'i sogs shlo ka gcig phyag byar 'os pa sogs shlo ka gcig gis phyag bya/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs mjug tu/ gu ru tri ratna maṇḍal pū dza me gha su mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pas maṇḍal 'bul/ mkhyen brtse nus ldan rgyal ba sras bcas rnams// bdag la brtse ba chen pos nyer dgongs nas// 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bdang*// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba 'debs so// de nas rje btsun ma la maṇḍal gsum 'bul ba'i dang po ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs po ta la nas rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ po ta la yi gnas mchog sogs shlo ka gcig oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ lha dang lha min sogs shlo ka gcig oṃ āryā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐/

de bzhin du pā dyaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar 'don pa bsgyur/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs nas/ gu ru tā rā badzra sogs nas/ hūm̐ gi bar brjod/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gnyis brjod/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang sogs shlo ka gcig oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ yi ge bcu pa nyer gcig bzla/ tā re nyer gcig bgrang*/ de nas/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can sogs sam/ bsdu na/ 'phags pa sgrol ma bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gi nyer 'tshe ma lus kun zhi nas// mthun rkyen re ba'i 'bras bu ma lus pa// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol ces brjod/ gnyis pa ni yang*/ lha dang lha min sogs shlo ka gcig mchod pa dang*/ maṇḍal shlo ka phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar gsum/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs/ yi ge bcu pa dang tā re gnyis gong bzhin bgrang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs/ gsol gdab bya/ gsum pa ni/ lha dang lha min sogs gyis bstod nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs maṇḍal dbul/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun/ āryā tā rā arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar/ lha mo la gus sogs dang yi ge bcu pa dang tā re gnyis gong bzhin/ 'phags ma sgrol ma bdag la dgongs su gsol zhes sogs shlo ka gcig gis gsol ba btab/ de nas arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la zhes sogs shlo ka gcig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ da lta zhal bzhugs pa thams cad sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring la 'gro don 'phel ba dang*/

dge 'dun gyi sde thams cad chos spyod bcu yi sgrub pa mi nyams shing 'phel ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad cing dus kyi 'khrugs pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ gtor ma rnams chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ āryā tā rā oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis sogs kyis bstod/ gnyis pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'di// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// bdag gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod// gsum pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ na maḥsarba sogs lan gsum/ de'i rjes su de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'di// rigs drug sems can rnams la sbyin// bkres skom sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems dang ldan gyur cig /bzhi pa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sambhā ra lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'di// gzhi bdag gnas bdag thams cad la// gus pas 'bul gyis bzhes nas kyang*// 'jig rten bde zhing chos 'phel dang*// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// ces pa'i mthar yig brgya lan gsum dang*// ma 'byor pa dang sogs nas bzod par mdzod/ bag med spyod pa ma dag pas// cho ga gzhung bzhin ma lcogs dang*// lhag chad 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa// thugs rjes bzod par mdzad du gsol// sgrol ma'i rten yod na/

oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā zhes me tog gtor/ rten med na ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// dngos grub nyer stsol bcom ldan mar// bstod sgrub gsol ba btab pa'i thabs// gong ma'i gsung las nyer btus te// blo gsal bzhed pa skong phyir sbyar// ces sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga bya tshul 'di'ang rab 'byams smra ba padma chos 'phel gyis bka' gnang ltar/ rje btsun chen po'i gsung rab las mdor bsdus go bde bar shāka btsun lhun grub kyis dben gnas rmor dgon par bris pa'o// ༈ /sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dngos sgrub myur stsol rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs// gangs can lha gcig dpal ldan a ti sha /spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul rgyal ba 'brom// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// bla ma la gus dpal ldan dgon pa ba// 'gro ba'i mgon po zhang ston ka ma ba// thugs rje'i gter chen bshes gnyen lum pa ba// gsol ba= /bka' gdams bstan pa'i nyi ma chu mig pa// mtshungs med sangs rgyas sgom pa seng ge skyabs// smra ba'i dbang phyug bshes gnyen dkon mchog grags// gsol ba= /stan gcig brtul zhugs 'dzin pa bde ba'i dpal// bka' bzhi smra ba grags pa gzhon nu'i zhabs// mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams grags// gsol ba= /srid gsum 'gran bral bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// mthu stobs dbang phyug sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal// thugs kyi sras mchog dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// gsol ba= /rgyal bas lung bstan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang= /mkhyen rab rin chen mchog tu grub pa'i zhabs// kun mkhyen gnyis pa shākya don grub la// gsol ba= /'jam dpal dbyangs dngos kun dga' legs grub dang*// skad gnyis smra ba she'u lo tsā ba// byams pa ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje la// gsol ba=

/sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// 'gro ba'i bla ma mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa la// gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol// cho ga bzhin du gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nad gdon nyer 'tshe'i tshogs rnams nyer zhi zhing*// bdag gis mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// 'bad med myur du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di'ang smra ba'i dbang phyug rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor bya bral ba kun dga' lhun grub kyis bkra shis chos sde'i bla brang du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
